goal_intent: book for two with a severe peanut allergy and ask how the kitchen handles allergens

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m calling to book a table for a little get-together — just two of us, and we’re really looking forward to a nice meal this Friday. Before we get too far, I wanted to check what steps your kitchen takes to handle severe peanut allergies.

Thanks so much for checking on that for me! Let’s go ahead and get the booking started while you’re finding out — we’re hoping for Friday at 7pm, under the name Sam Ellery. It’ll just be the two of us, and one of us has the peanut allergy, so I’d love for that to be noted on the reservation.

That’s perfect, thank you! I’ll look out for your call about the kitchen’s allergy procedures, and I really appreciate you making sure everything’s safe for us. Looking forward to Friday! 

[END OF CALL]
